description.value: A mid-range motel operating under the Sonesta/Canada's Best Value Inn brand, positioned at the historic 'Mile 0' landmark in Lillooet — a natural gateway to the BC Interior for cyclists travelling the Gold Rush Trail or Fraser Canyon corridor. The property offers a range of room types from standard rooms with mini-fridges and microwaves to a family suite and a honeymoon suite with jetted tub, all in a compact Main Street location within easy walking distance of several restaurants. Truck and bus parking is listed as a property feature, suggesting the site can accommodate larger vehicles and loaded bikes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM address (616 Main Street, Lillooet, BC V0K 1V0) and phone (250-256-7511). The hotel features section explicitly lists Guest Laundry, Vending/Ice Machines, and WiFi Internet; nearby evening food is confirmed by multiple named restaurants within 0.2–1.3 km. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific staff procedures, drying area, grocery, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere in the content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with a live website, confirmed address and phone, and multiple guest amenities. A useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Lillooet.
